LESSON: READING 11.2.1 INTENSIVE READING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.2: Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading, part of Strand 11 in Grade 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to relate what you read to real life experiences? 2. What digital resources can you use in your reading?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. infer the meaning of words from context,

2. make connections between town experiences and events in the reading text.

3. create pictures, mimes, videos or crossword puzzles with peers,

4. search and read texts from the internet with peers,

5. dramatise or role play events or characters in stories they have read online,

6. print the visuals obtained from online sources and share or display in a gallery. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. infer the meaning of words from context,
2. make connections between town experiences and events in the reading text.
3. create pictures, mimes, videos or crossword puzzles with peers,
4. search and read texts from the internet with peers,
5. dramatise or role play events or characters in stories they have read online,
6. print the visuals obtained from online sources and share or display in a gallery. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical Thinking and Problem Solving is cultivated as the learner engages in research online.

• Digital Literacy is enhanced as the learner searches and reads texts from the internet with peers.

Values:
Integrity is inculcated as the learner avoids breach of confidentiality and security while they use technology

responsibly.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Safety and security is enhanced with the learner’s responsible use of internet while reading the online visuals

intensively.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner relates intensive reading done here to similar concepts learnt in Kiswahili.
